title: CULTURALLY RESPONSIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE – PROBLEMS, CHALLENGES AND SOLUTIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images using a proprietary generative AI algorithm with varying cultural prompts (e.g., 'Wealthy African man and his house' vs. 'Wealthy European man and his house') to visually observe the amplification of cultural stereotypes, alongside synthesizing literature on cultural alignment.
Comparing the performance accuracy of the GPT-4 model across different languages (e.g., English vs. Telugu) on the MMLU benchmark to demonstrate technological exclusion.

Reviewing empirical studies that evaluate disparities in AI system performance, such as computer vision models mislabeling objects held by dark-skinned individuals and healthcare algorithms reducing care assignments for Black patients.

Citing the MIT Gender Shades project to evaluate accuracy disparities in commercial face-recognition algorithms when performing gender classification across varying intersectional groups (lighter vs. darker-skinned males and females).
